query.text: 请帮我留意洗衣机运行，出现明显异常晃动或异常声响时及时提醒我。
query.text_en: Please monitor the washing machine and alert me to obvious abnormal shaking or unusual sounds.

annotation.text_zh: 洗衣机出现异常声响，请留意运行情况。
annotation.text_en: The washing machine is making an unusual sound; please check its operation.

annotation.text_zh: 洗衣机正在明显移位，请停止使用并检查。
annotation.text_en: The washing machine is visibly shifting position; stop using it and check it.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
